topic: Filler words and the two-second pause
hook: This is a common mistake almost every speaker makes.
script: This is a common mistake almost every speaker makes. If you're not doing this, your best ideas get lost. Filler words like um and uh spike when your brain outruns your mouth. So slow down. Pause instead of filling. A two second silence sounds like control to your listener, not like a gap. Record one minute of yourself today and count the ums. That number drops once you see it.
caption:
Filler words rise when your brain moves ahead of your mouth. Pausing fixes it. A two second silence reads as control to a listener, while um reads as searching. Record one minute of yourself, count the fillers, then repeat for a week. Most speakers halve the count.
